claim_scope: Original composition totals and invalid sample exclusions are audited.
limitations: Case is Development and historically contaminated; old internal test labels are exposed.
CV, subtype geometry and bootstrap stability do not establish external scientific truth.
Unknown decision scores and KNN votes are not calibrated probabilities.
Permutation and bootstrap outputs are exploratory with no multiplicity adjustment.
Backcasts are conditional and not causal estimates; unknown labels remain unavailable.

REQ-1A.claim_text: Weathering associations use bounded 999-shuffle permutation checks with sparse-table limitations.

REQ-1B.claim_text: Type and weathering centers weight each artifact equally within strata; associations are descriptive.

REQ-1C.claim_text: Artifact-level pre-weathering backcasts assume type exchangeability; sparse pairs do not identify a causal effect.

REQ-2A.claim_text: Two-repeat CV covers only effective train-plus-validation artifacts; previously exposed Development labels do not establish external performance.

REQ-2B.claim_text: Exploratory subtypes include chemical centers and artifact counts; silhouette does not prove scientific validity.

REQ-2C.claim_text: Subtype stability uses bounded artifact resampling and actual composition perturbations with nonzero feature changes.

REQ-3A.claim_text: Eight unknown samples receive predictions; their unavailable labels prevent a claim of unknown-sample accuracy.

REQ-3B.claim_text: Unknown predictions include training-distance domain checks and perturbation flips; model scores are uncalibrated.

REQ-4A.claim_text: Within-type chemical associations weight artifacts equally and preserve undefined correlations as null.

REQ-4B.claim_text: Between-type association differences have exploratory 30-bootstrap ranges without multiplicity or causal guarantees.

REQ-COMPOSITION.claim_text: Valid composition vectors close to one under the declared nondetection assumption.

REQ-EVIDENCE.claim_text: Development outputs distinguish measured diagnostics, conditional analyses and unresolved scientific requirements.

REQ-VALIDITY.claim_text: Original composition totals and invalid sample exclusions are audited.

failure_cases: Repeated predictions are not independent artifacts.
Sparse paired artifacts cannot identify causal weathering.
Training-distance applicability does not establish unknown classification accuracy.

REQ-1A.scope_limitation: Previously exposed Development collection; conditional backcast, exploratory statistics and uncalibrated predictions do not establish unknown accuracy or causality.
